definitions.explanation: A container for cigarette ash and butts.

examples.japanese: {灰皿|はいざら}はどこですか。
{灰皿|はいざら}を{空|から}にする。
テーブルに{灰皿|はいざら}がある。
examples.english: There is an ashtray on the table.

notes:
{灰皿|はいざら} is used for cigarette ash.

COMPONENTS:
- {灰|はい} (ash)
- {皿|さら} (plate, dish)

RELATED WORDS:
- たばこ (cigarette)
- {喫煙|きつえん} (smoking)
- {禁煙|きんえん} (no smoking)

NOTE: Less common now due to reduced smoking and smoking bans in many places.
